fixes: Removed the first advantage card's zero left inset and restored mobile card insets.
Removed the single-project filter override that cleared the description's padding.
Added side and bottom insets to the production photograph caption.
Aligned dropdown positioning and height with the shared header height; allowed the header to grow with enlarged text.
Removed clipped decorative hero-panel copy at tablet widths.
Prevented long words and minimum grid widths from pushing text outside cards and columns at 200% text enlargement.
Prevented catalog process numbers from shrinking into adjacent text.
Corrected solution hero image sizes on 601–820px viewports; verified selection of the 960px source at 601, 768 and 820px.

validation.textEnlargement: Each element's computed font size was measured before applying a 2x multiplier; this simulates text-only enlargement.
validation.gestureEvidence: Existing Chromium tests exercised mouse dragging, wheel scrolling, reduced motion, and synthesized touch swipes on the partner marquee.
validation.detectorExceptions: Generic font warnings concern the user-pinned Montserrat brand face and the inherited Arial fallback; existing design-scale advisories were reviewed without redesigning the approved identity.

limitations: Browser automation ran on Windows using Chromium, Firefox and Playwright WebKit with emulated viewport sizes.
Physical iOS and Android devices were not tested. WebKit on Windows does not establish physical Safari-device coverage.
